48113.notes: Redeemable deed (Texas Tax Code Ch. 34). Dallas County Sheriff runs monthly tax foreclosure sales as a live online auction via RealAuction (distinct from the separate in-person Writ of Execution sheriff's sale). Struck-off / tax foreclosure resales are handled by Dallas County Public Works.

auctionPlatform.label: RealAuction — Dallas County Sheriff Sale Auctions

48113.auctionFrequency: First Tuesday of every month, online bidding begins 9:00 a.m. CST
48113.depositRules: Register on the RealAuction site (877-361-7325 / customerservice@realauction.com). Tax-sale payments are by wire transfer only via RealAuction; deposit amount and cleared-funds deadline are posted on the platform per sale. Obtain any required written statement of no delinquent taxes from the Tax Office before a deed can issue (Texas Tax Code §34.015).

clerkOfCourt.label: Dallas County Clerk (official public / real property records)

48113.survivingLiens: HOA/POA liens can survive a Texas tax sale if the association recorded its lien and was not properly joined/notified in the foreclosure suit. Federal tax liens survive (IRS rights). Post-judgment taxes and unjoined municipal liens may also remain — search deed records before bidding.
48113.quietTitle: Not legally mandatory, but title companies generally require a completed suit to quiet title before insuring, because of statutory redemption rights and possible un-joined lienholders.
